theme: An open day, with travel windows closing fast.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty, Dan — just the NACD New England committee at 1. The weight today is the travel stack: Croatia transfers to lock in from land before the boat, and a cluster of Florida and Maine bookings whose windows are about to close.

needsAttention.title: Lock Croatia transfers before Saturday
needsAttention.detail: The charter disembarks Cavtat Sat Sept 19 — the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a hotel bag-hold, and a ~5:15 AM Sept 20 checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from dry land, and connectivity on the boat is thin to none.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete Airbnb before it charges
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking (~$2,331) charges Sept 18 — verify the host accepted it rather than letting it expire, and switch to a better option now if one exists, since after the 18th it is paid.

needsAttention.title: Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car at TPA
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sept 20 at 3:55 PM; the full-size SUV for Sept 20–Oct 5 is no longer a hedge. Book it now rather than facing walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Two St Pete nights, Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: The nights between your Croatia landing and the Tue Sept 22 kid pickup are still unbooked — somewhere in St Pete for the 20th and 21st before the drive to the Orlando villa.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV from PWM over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book it refundable this week — it is the next time all four girls are up in Maine with no six-seater there.

flagged.title: myFICO account alert
flagged.detail: A monitored account balance decreased — informational only, nothing to action.

inbox.noise: About 35 unread, nearly all newsletters and promotions — Maine papers, retail, Substacks, and travel deals.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are crisp and tart now, made for a free-form galette.

tasks.title: Buy 6 Disney tickets, Sept 26–27 — check park reservations and Halloween-party night

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before midday — the morning is entirely yours.
One hour with the NACD New England programming committee at 1, then the day reopens.
